name: minio
launch: export MINIO_ROOT_USER=sunrisedata && export MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=sunrisedata && cd minio && ./bin/minio server --console-address ":9001" ./data

additional.mac: osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to activate' -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "ssh -N -L localhost:8888:localhost:8888 $user@$ip"'

description.zh: MinIO：这是一款高性能高可用的文件系统服务。
description.en: MinIO's High Performance Object Storage is Open Source, Amazon S3 compatible, Kubernetes Native and is designed for cloud native workloads like AI.
